title: Liquid flow measurement in open channels by weirs and flumes - Triangular profile weirs
clause_1_scope: This standard specifies methods for the measurement of the flow of water in open channels under steady flow conditions using triangular proflle weirs. The flow conditions considered are steady flows which are uniquely dependent on the upstreair* head and drowned flows which depend on downstream as well as upstream, levels.
clause_3_terminology: Liquid flow measurement in open channels by weirs and flumes

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
